belief_update: I am 24, nonbinary, working retail and going to community college part-time, and I have been feeling low for a while now. Some days I catch myself wondering if this is really as bad as it feels, like maybe I'm just tired and making more of it than I should. I can say the word 'depression' to some people but not to coworkers or others who might repeat it. I don't let people know how much I'm struggling, even though I know plenty of people go through this too. I don't think I'm any worse of a person for feeling this way, but I still catch myself thinking I should be handling it better. I expect that if people knew, they might not understand or might think I'm just being dramatic, but I know I'm not alone in this.
